name: NeRF Ray Marching Optimizations
aliases: Occupancy Grids for Empty Space Skipping
definition: A set of three techniques to optimize NeRF ray marching performance with imperceptible error: exponential stepping, empty space skipping, and sample compaction.
summary: NeRF Ray Marching Optimizations accelerate rendering by using occupancy grids to skip empty space and adaptive step sizes, achieving imperceptible error.
